channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: sugar (Memory & Context)
item.description: Sugar is local-first infrastructure for coordinating coding agents through a durable SQLite task queue, with atomic claims and leases. It also provides project and global memory, searchable locally with embeddings or FTS5, and records task and harness activity in an append-only event history.

item.title: membase (Memory & Context)
item.description: Hosted Membase memory provider for Hermes with scoped recall, explicit saves and opt-in user-turn capture.

item.title: memoria (Memory & Context)
item.description: Native Hermes memory provider for Memoria Cloud or self-hosted APIs, with bounded recall and opt-in fact capture.

item.title: monitor (Memory & Context)
item.description: BetterDB Monitor collects and stores Valkey and Redis monitoring data, including slowlogs, command patterns, client activity, and latency history. It provides analytics for clusters, clients, keys, and anomalies, and can run with Docker, Kubernetes/Helm, or its CLI.

item.title: hermes-dreaming (Memory & Context)
item.description: hermes-dreaming is a deterministic nightly memory-consolidation tool for Hermes Agent. Its Python script checks conversations and stored memory, then reports candidate facts, conflicts, and other memory issues for the agent to handle through its regular memory tool; on quiet nights, it can skip waking the model.

item.title: lcm-x (Memory & Context)
item.description: LCM-X is a context engine for Hermes Agent that stores messages in a plugin-local SQLite database and compacts older context into hierarchical summaries. It keeps the active prompt bounded and provides tools to search, inspect, and expand compacted material while preserving access to raw messages in normal operation.

item.title: optmem-hermes-plugin (Memory & Context)
item.description: Local append-only Hermes memory provider with decay compression, BM25 retrieval and reversible native-memory migration.

item.title: hermes-gbrain (Memory & Context)
item.description: Community Hermes plugin connecting GBrain memory over MCP, with profile setup and maintenance helpers.

item.title: hermes-official-plugins (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Nous Research’s collection of first-party Hermes plugins for integrations, tools, providers, backends and Desktop extensions.

item.title: hwiki (Memory & Context)
item.description: Markdown wiki memory provider for Hermes with local SQLite FTS5 recall and append-only memory notes.

item.title: HyAtlas-Memory (Memory & Context)
item.description: HyAtlas Memory is a Go-based memory server with an embedded vector store and in-process BGE-small embeddings. It organizes memories into eight layers, supports Lite, Pro, and Ultra modes, and can retire memories with reasons so they can be restored.

item.title: ReMe (Memory & Context)
item.description: File-native agent memory that turns conversations into searchable Markdown and integrates with Hermes over HTTP or an embedded backend.

item.title: superlocalmemory (Memory & Context)
item.description: Local-first shared agent memory with governed retrieval, MCP access and a native Hermes lifecycle plugin.

item.title: Compartment (Memory & Context)
item.description: Encrypted offline memory vault for Hermes and MCP agents with local semantic and keyword retrieval.

item.title: hermes-plugin-holographic (Memory & Context)
item.description: Holographic Memory Provider is a local memory provider for Hermes Agent that stores facts in SQLite and supports FTS5 search, trust scoring, entity resolution, and holographic retrieval. By default, it requires no API key, network access, or model calls; meaning-based search is an optional online add-on.

item.title: hermes-supermemory (Memory & Context)
item.description: Supermemory memory provider for Hermes with semantic recall, profile facts and automatic conversation capture.

item.title: hermes-sanctuary (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Sanctuary is a Hermes plugin that visualizes an agent’s tool use through Greek mythology characters in a live panorama. It tracks tool names, times, and counts, and shows alerts for issues such as repeated calls, fallback models, and budget overruns; it also includes a daily journal, day replay, and shareable image.

item.title: youtube-transcript-hermes-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: This Hermes Agent plugin connects to the GetYouTubeTranscript remote MCP server for transcripts, video search, and channel and playlist browsing. It includes four skills for fetching transcripts, searching YouTube, summarizing videos, and researching channels and playlists.

item.title: FlipsiBridge (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: FlipsiBridge connects an Android device to a Hermes server so an AI agent can use device actions such as camera, screen, files, and notifications. It uses an encrypted chat and a self-hosted relay; the phone connects to the relay over WebSocket and can work behind NAT without port forwarding.

item.title: iris (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: Iris is an open-source phone app for connecting to and controlling your own Hermes Agent through its dashboard. It supports chat, voice calls, conversation management, and server features such as scheduled jobs and tasks when available; it also includes an offline demo.

item.title: hermes-integration (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Fax for Agents for Hermes Agent provides a workflow skill and MCP configuration for sending and receiving faxes with approval controls. It supports a hosted OAuth connection and a portable stdio setup; the README reports that hosted OAuth was tested with Hermes 0.22.7, while a live stdio connection has not been tested.

item.title: guide-hermes-agent (Guides & Docs)
item.description: Guide en français pour installer et configurer Hermes Agent, le relier à un modèle d’IA et à une messagerie, puis le faire tourner sur un serveur. Il couvre aussi des pratiques de sécurité et les coûts possibles, et renvoie à la documentation officielle pour les détails à jour.

item.title: hermes-linkedin-jobsearch (Domain Applications)
item.description: hermes-linkedin-jobsearch is a Hermes profile that searches LinkedIn on a schedule, researches employers, prepares tailored resumes and application answers from your profile facts, and tracks applications. You control what gets sent: Easy Apply requires your instruction by default, while external forms are sent only if you opt in.

item.title: hermes-finance (Domain Applications)
item.description: hermes-finance is a self-hosted personal-finance dashboard that stores account, balance, and transaction data in a local SQLite file. It supports Plaid connections and manual accounts or CSV, OFX, and QFX imports, and tracks spending categories, budgets, bills, goals, loans, investments, and net worth. An AI agent can access the same financial data through native tools, MCP, or the dashboard’s Ask panel.

item.title: hermes-mock-review (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: mock-review is a Hermes plugin for reviewing UI and design options through shareable review boards. Reviewers can approve, request changes, or skip decisions, add notes and pins, then send feedback that wakes the agent in the originating chat. Boards display mocks at desktop, tablet, and phone widths in light and dark modes.

item.title: pomelu (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Pomelu is a free, open-source mobile app for connecting to a self-hosted Hermes Agent from Android and iOS devices. It provides bot-based chats with live answers, voice and file sharing, questions and approvals, notifications, and Bot Screen access when configured on a Linux gateway.

item.title: pomelu-hermes-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: This Hermes plugin routes certain scheduled messages created in Pomelu chats back to the bot chat and tells the bot how to message users later. It can also send push notifications with the bot’s name and the start of its reply to registered phones when Pomelu is not open.

item.title: hermes-remote-browser (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Remote Browser lets a Hermes Agent running on a server connect to Chrome on another computer through a browser extension and relay. You choose which tabs to share using a purple Hermes tab group, and browser access is off by default.

item.title: keryx (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Keryx is a live, read-only dashboard for viewing activity recorded by Hermes Agent. It reads the agent’s files and presents them in a 3D force graph, with panels for sessions, tasks, analytics and logs.

item.title: hol-guard (Developer Tools)
item.description: HOL Guard is a local-first security layer for AI agents that reviews shell commands, file access, package installs, and MCP tool calls before they run. It detects risks such as secret exposure, destructive operations, prompt injection, and supply-chain threats, then allows, blocks, or requests approval according to policy.
